name: axiom-global-notices
description: AXIOM AI global feedback: SDK Alert/Button, Shadow DOM isolation, queued native confirmations. Success/error notices auto-dismiss independently 5 seconds after delivery; manual dismiss cancels expiry. Confirmations wait for user input. Build uses AXIOM_SDK_REPO dependencies; deploy dist/axiom-feedback.js to public/axiom-feedback.js. Never link the inspection-only shadow CSS globally. SDK MIT notice emitted beside bundle.
